faqs.question: What is the difference between IELTS Academic and General Training?
faqs.answer: IELTS Academic is strictly for candidates applying for higher education (Bachelors, Masters, PhD) or professional registration in medical/nursing fields. IELTS General Training is primarily for permanent residency (PR immigration like Canada Express Entry, Australia SkillSelect) and secondary education or work visas.

faqs.question: How often are Mock Tests conducted at First Class Institute?
faqs.answer: We conduct full-length sectional tests every Wednesday and a complete 3-hour official timed Mock Test every Saturday in exam conditions with question papers strictly following the latest IDP exam pattern. Your results and detailed band breakdown are provided within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Do you provide 1-on-1 Speaking practice with individual trainers?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every enrolled student is assigned a dedicated speaking slot every single day in our private acoustic speaking cabins. You are interviewed just like the real IELTS speaking test, recorded for review, and given immediate feedback on fluency, pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.

faqs.question: Is the study material included in the course fee?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We provide Cambridge IELTS Books (1 to 19), our exclusive 8-Band Lexical Vocabulary Guide, 150+ Solved Writing Task 1 & 2 Essays, Speaking Cue Card prediction kits, and 24x7 access to our online student portal.

faqs.question: Can I attend a free demo class before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes, we encourage all students to take a Free Diagnostic Test and attend a 2-hour Live Demo Class to experience our teaching methodology, computer lab, and interact with our master trainers before making any payment.
